data.standardized_narrative: At the start of 2014 the syndicate had gross claims outstanding of GBP 554.9m. During 2014 prior-year reserves showed a net decrease of GBP 18.0m (a release, c.3.2% of opening reserves), which the report describes as differences between current year-end provisions and previous estimates (favourable claims development). The managing agent notes specific large loss activity in Aviation during 2014 (Tripoli Airport attack) and the material impact of Super storm Sandy on the 2012 year of account, but the stated prior-year reserve movement for 2014 is an overall release.

data.data_quality_notes: The disclosed prior-year movement (-GBP 18.0m) is taken from the note titled 'Change in the net provision for claims' and appears to be a net (after reinsurance) figure; no explicit GROSS prior-year movement (insurance liabilities column) was identified in the notes. As a result the prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the available net figure and is flagged with reduced confidence. No gross claims development triangle was found in the report to cross-check a gross PYD.
